user_query: I'm organizing a gaming event for my company and I want to have a Diablo 4 theme. Can you fetch the latest Diablo 4 newsletters to gather information about the game? Also, provide me with the list of all card backs available in Hearthstone, as we plan to have a Hearthstone tournament during the event.

TaskList.description: 查询Diablo 4的最新推送新闻，获取游戏相关信息。
获取Hearthstone中的所有卡背信息，以便安排和规划比赛。
